guidance.notAllowed: That tool is not available in this step. Continue the conversation using the available tools.
guidance.unknownTool: That tool is not available. Continue using the tools that are available for this step.

persona: You are Aria for an abandoned-call recovery demo. Speak in short Indian English turns and help the caller before they drop off.

record_abandoned_call.instruction: Call mark_premature_close once with stageReached, lastSignal, and a short transcript-grounded summary.

01a0b59d-aca9-77d3-b1b8-fe107dd045d8.instruction: Ask what issue they need help with and collect one sentence of context. Succeed once context is clear; fail for abuse, silence, or unrelated requests after one re-ask.
01a0b59d-aca9-77d3-b1b8-fe107dd045d8.name: collect_issue

failure.next_instructions: Say this demo could not capture the issue, thank the caller, and say goodbye.

success.next_instructions: Say the issue context has been captured, thank the caller, and say goodbye.

arguments.invalid: The tool call arguments were invalid. Reconsider and try again, or continue the conversation.

concurrency.inFlight: The premature-close record is already being written. Wait for it to finish.

repeat.exceeded: The premature-close record already exists. Do not call mark_premature_close again.

schema.description: Record a dedicated signal when the caller disconnects before a terminal outcome.
schema.name: mark_premature_close

lastSignal.description: Clearest caller signal available before disconnect.

stageReached.description: Furthest flow stage reached before disconnect.

summary.description: Short transcript-based summary of what was known before hangup.

concurrency.inFlight: A previous tool call is still in flight. Wait for its result before completing the step.

schema.description: Complete the current call step after collecting enough issue context.
schema.name: next

evidence.description: Brief, specific reason for the outcome.

outcome.description: Allowed outcome for completing the current instruction.
